goal: Widen dashboard/reviews/history in place into the Reviews list: Unanswered-then-Answered grouping, per-row Generate (never-replied) and Regenerate (already-replied) wired to the existing On-demand generation cost policy, the gap/historical split replaced by per-row provenance badges, and PAST_REPLIES_VIEW_ENABLED retired.
non_goals: A new page or route for the Reviews list — reviews/history is widened in place (S1)
Any change to the Needs Action queue at dashboard/reviews beyond the tab label (S2)
A second auto-approval guard — invariant #3's exclusion is asserted, never re-spelled (ticket body, spec §6.4)
Any change to generate-draft.ts's `version > 1` regen-budget guard (C1)
Any change to BURST_MAX / HOUR_MAX — C2 already landed in PR #702
Any change to the publish transport; DELETE-then-POST stays inside ResponsePublisherWorker (#669 audit)
Routing Generate's publish through past-replies/publish — it reuses reviews/[reviewId]/approve (#669 audit)
Setting DAILY_COST_LIMIT_CENTS_COPILOT / _AUTOPILOT — C4 is a launch constraint, not a code task
Rating-ordering or a pinned-negatives band inside Unanswered — D6 declined the third grouping level (S6)
Retiring EDIT_REPLIES_ENABLED — it gates the live-Google mutation and is kept (S4)
user_visible_behavior: The Reviews tab bar reads `Needs Action` / `All Reviews` (was `History`), and `All Reviews` renders unconditionally now that PAST_REPLIES_VIEW_ENABLED is retired
The Reviews list shows every review for the location — not only replied ones — grouped `Unanswered` then `Answered`, newest-first inside each group, 50 per page
A never-replied review shows `Generate`; clicking expands the row inline to the generated draft with `Approve & post` (S7)
An already-replied review shows `Regenerate`, which opens the existing EditReplyDrawer two-pane comparison (S7), with `N of 3 today` beside it, disabled at 3 of 3
A review with a pending draft that is NOT moderation-held shows a `Draft ready` cross-link to Needs Action and no `Generate` button (S2)
A review whose draft is held by moderation shows a muted `Under review` marker with no Generate, no draft text, and no cross-link (invariant #4)
A review whose generation is in flight shows `Generating…` and no `Generate` button, and survives a page refresh in that state
An orphan row (repost failed, no live Google reply) sits in `Unanswered` with its existing recovery card and no `Generate`
Answered rows carry a provenance badge: `Posted by you before joining`, `Replied on Google`, `Auto-approved`, or `You approved` (S3)
The stat tiles read Total reviews / Unanswered / Answered / Avg rating, with Avg rating computed over ALL reviews for the location
Exceeding the shared per-owner rate limit returns 429 `rate_limited`; exceeding the per-review daily cap returns 429 `regen_limit_reached`
invariants: Invariant #3 — no unapproved posting: a Generate draft must never be auto-approval-eligible. Held structurally by the new origin lane (isAutoApprovalCandidate requires live_ingest_new) plus suppress_notification: true. Asserted by test, never re-gated.
Invariant #2 — transactional outbox: the Generate enqueue goes through enqueueGenerateResponse inside the route's own sql.begin, never a raw INSERT and never a post-commit enqueue
Invariant #8 — tenant scope: every list query and the Generate route's review lookup filter on the owner-resolved business_id via businesses.account_id with archived_at IS NULL
Invariant #13 — server-authoritative flags: no NEXT_PUBLIC_* companion; editRepliesEnabled stays a server read passed down as a prop
Invariant #15 — domain modules take their DB client explicitly; load-replies.ts keeps its `sql: Sql` parameter and the route stays the composition root
Invariant #1 — Vercel = UI only: the batched regen-budget peek is an Upstash cache read (established practice on this exact path); no LLM or external-provider call enters the route

Regenerate publish stays gated behind EDIT_REPLIES_ENABLED (#669 hard constraint — with the flag off the publisher's edit block is inert and a publish would POST without the DELETE). Generate's publish path (/approve) is deliberately NOT gated on it.
Rate limits keep failing open; the regen-budget peek fails open to `no counter shown, button enabled`. The authoritative gate stays the worker's Lua INCR.
edge_cases: A review with a non-terminal response (pending_approval / approved / edited / awaiting_owner_connect) groups as Unanswered because it has no posted sibling, but must render `Draft ready` and never `Generate`

A review with an in-flight generate_response outbox row (pending/dispatching/dispatched) renders `Generating…`; without the second LATERAL a refresh would re-offer Generate and burn a rate-limit token to learn it 409s

Discarding a draft sets status='superseded' and RETAINS the row, so MAX(version) is preserved and the next Generate is version >= 2 and charged — C1's self-arming holds and there is no free-regeneration loop

A never-replied review whose per-review counter is already at 3/3 today is refused by the peek even though version 1 would be free by C1; this is the policy working, and only reachable after 3 charged attempts on that review
An externally-answered review dated AFTER activation gets `Replied on Google`, not `Posted by you before joining` — the owner replied in Google's UI while subscribed
Orphan rows have no posted sibling but DO have a superseded draft; offering Generate would race the /retry and /restore-original recovery path
The two COUNT(*) totals and the orphan query must move with the JOIN or the section denominators and totalPages go wrong (#671 landmine 3)
totalPages must be computed from all reviews, not from posted-only counts, or the last pages of a mostly-unanswered import become unreachable
A batched budget peek rendered server-side can go stale across UTC midnight, briefly showing a disabled Regenerate that the route would now allow; a refresh corrects it
Redis unavailable → peekRegenBudgetBatch returns an empty map, no counters render, and every Regenerate button stays enabled (fail open)
A Generate on a review owned by another account must 404 from the tenant-scoped lookup, not leak existence
A review whose location is archived (businesses.archived_at NOT NULL) must not be generatable

rollback_plan: No migration — the change is query + route + UI only, so rollback is `git revert` of the squash-merge commit plus a redeploy of Vercel and Railway. PAST_REPLIES_VIEW_ENABLED is DELETED rather than flipped, so there is no flag to turn back: reverting restores the flag read, and the env var must be present on Railway/Vercel before the reverted build boots or the list 404s. Its current per-environment values must be captured via the flag-flip skill BEFORE the deletion lands, and recorded in the PR description as the revert precondition. EDIT_REPLIES_ENABLED is untouched and remains the kill switch for the live-Google mutation on the Regenerate lane — flipping it off disables Regenerate publish without reverting anything. Prod holds 0 businesses, so there is no data-loss exposure; the new origin lane value is payload-only (no schema constraint), so in-flight outbox rows carrying it drain harmlessly against a reverted worker (KNOWN_ORIGIN_LANES tolerates unknown lanes as null).
observability: New structured log on the Generate door: `{ event: 'on_demand_generate_enqueued', reviewId, businessId, version, outboxId }` via createWorkerLogger — proves the door fired and which version was charged
Existing `rate_limit_exceeded` (route: dashboard_regenerate) now also fires for the Generate door, so the shared counter is observable as one stream per C3
Existing `regen_budget_peek_failed` covers both the route peek and the new batch peek; a spike means the counters silently vanished from the list while the worker gate still holds
reportCaughtError('reviews/generate', …) sends route failures to Sentry with reviewId/accountId context, mirroring past-replies/draft
Run-spine rows (agent_runs / agent_run_steps / agent_outcomes) record the draft exactly as the live lane does — an on-demand draft with no spine row means persist.ts diverged

How I would know it broke: owners clicking Generate produce no job_outbox rows with topic generate_response and origin_lane on_demand_generate, or the Reviews list renders zero Unanswered rows for a location whose import_decision is 'accepted'
